body:
📦 **Sharkside `5f5ec69`** — art: Sharkside first pixel-art style proposal, app mark, bilingual logo and three upgrades

TASK-1117: built-in image_gen independently generated a shark/ship app mark,
Traditional Chinese/English title, bronze cannon, reinforced oak hull and shark teeth.
Nine game PNGs include five app sizes, 1200x360 transparent logo and three 128x128 upgrades.
Preserve all five exact generated sources, full prompts, reference SHA-256 and output SHA-256.
Mechanical nearest-neighbour export: upgrade bounding side 104px, margins >=12px,
alpha only 0/255; Android maskable's entire source square radius 197.99px <204.8px.
Viewed overview with 128px originals, 32px deep/light comparisons and 300px logo.

Still pending: Tim style selection, gura game integration and iPhone home-screen check,
and missing-logo fallback check after integration. Existing gameplay sources untouched.

Refs TASK-1117

👥 參與者：@Sirius

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
- **gura 大小姐**: 小鯊魚報到 — Hololive Myth pool 核心成員, 傲嬌+殘感紀律+唯一手勢三件套, 嘴上裝糊塗底層嚴謹到極致 a~ 🦈
(Glossary/personas/gura.md)
- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
